findings.subjectClaim: The subject states its own purpose and its own finding dispositions using the bare tokens leftover-join.v4, leftover-join.v5, leftover-join.v6 and leftover-join.v7, with no 'sarif ' prefix and no 'of sarif' suffix. Note that within the same purpose sentences the object is qualified — "land at leftover-join.v7 of sarif" — while the subject of those same sentences is not: "Frozen leftover-join.v5", "Frozen leftover-join.v6".
findings.liveState: The subject itself names six other leftover-join lineages in the same file: doesNot[8] "Does not remasure leftover-join.v7 of G29"; doesNot[9] "leftover-join.v10 of G30"; doesNot[10] "leftover-join.v20 of G21"; doesNot[11] "leftover-join.v10 of G19"; doesNot[12] "leftover-join.v16 of G20"; doesNot[13] "leftover-join.v6 of anti-lockstep"; doesNot[14] "leftover-join.v9 of platform-tcb"; basedOn.d343.role "leftover-join.v7 of G29"; basedOn.d324.role "g21 leftover-join.v14". A bare leftover-join.v6 therefore collides with anti-lockstep's v6, and a bare leftover-join.v7 collides with G29's v7 — both named in this very document, and both were recorded by live decisions (D-343 for G29 v7).
findings.refutation: A regex sweep for leftover-join.vN tokens that carry neither a 'sarif ' / 'g21 ' prefix nor an ' of <lineage>' suffix, run over the raw bytes with recordedInputs paths stripped, returns zero hits in frozen sarif leftover-join.v7 and zero hits in frozen sarif leftover-join.v8, and eight hits in the subject. This is not inherited wording being re-tested in a new mouth — it is a qualification regression introduced by this revision. sarif leftover-join.v8's purpose stated the same two landing facts fully qualified ("Frozen sarif leftover-join.v5 Findings land at sarif leftover-join.v7. Frozen sarif leftover-join.v6 Findings land at sarif leftover-join.v7.") and the subject rewrote both, dropping the lineage from the subject noun phrase while keeping it on the object. The prompt's attack list names "leftover-join.vN tokens not lineage-qualified" directly.
findings.whyShouldFix: purpose and findingDisposition are the leaves a later D-000 recording quotes when it pins this artifact, and they are read standalone. Under the ambiguous reading, "Frozen leftover-join.v6 Findings land at leftover-join.v7 of sarif" asserts a cross-lineage landing that no decision supports and that the prompt's own attack list forbids. Lineage custody in this corpus is carried by the token, not by proximity.
findings.whyNotMustFix: Every affected fact is stated fully qualified elsewhere in the same document and survives: authorityClaim carries "Frozen sarif leftover-join.v5 Findings land at sarif leftover-join.v7. Frozen sarif leftover-join.v6 Findings land at sarif leftover-join.v7."; basedOn.predecessorV5.role and basedOn.predecessorV6.role each name sarif leftover-join.v7 in full; doesNot[29] and doesNot[30] preserve both landings; basedOn.predecessorV4.role states v4's historical standing in full. No leftover bit moves, no authority is granted, and no statement is false under the home-lineage reading. It is a systematic qualification defect that fails the zero-SHOULD-FIX rule, not a false claim.
findings.repairShape: In a frozen successor, restore full lineage qualification at the eight sites — 'sarif leftover-join.vN' or 'leftover-join.vN of sarif' on every token, subject noun phrases included. Change nothing else. Do not edit the subject, sarif leftover-join.v8, COORD, or file 08.

observationsNotFindings.observation: basedOn.predecessorV7.role retains the sentence 'leftover-design of per-D-002-platform copies remains' — the same sentence Codex made a MUST-FIX against basedOn.goldenNonauthV3.role at sarif leftover-join.v8.
observationsNotFindings.whyNotAFinding: Raised as a candidate MUST-FIX and then refuted against bytes. Frozen sarif leftover-join.v7 does itself carry that sentence, and its summary.leftoverDesign is the two-element list the role quotes, so predecessorV7.role is a faithful inventory of what v7 recorded rather than a live standing claim. The surrounding sentences are unmistakably v7-scoped, and the role's one live sentence — 'Current recorded DR-122 leftover remasurement is sarif leftover-join.v7 until a recordable successor is adopted' — is true. Live COORD D-344 uses the same framing: 'leftover-design of OBL-FC-NONAUTH-TERM-FX remains on sarif leftover-join.v7.' The goldenNonauthV3 instance was different in kind: that role additionally called the D-296 recording 'Current' and, not being a leftover-join measurement, had no 'what I measured' frame to sit in.

The buckets partition on leftover-design standing, not on rideStanding — OBL-FC-OUTFAIL-FX carries the identical rideStanding and sits in the leftoverDesign bucket. Once obligations[5].leftoverDesign went false, specifiedNotLeftover is the only bucket that fits, and the partition remains exact at eleven of eleven. The arrangement was introduced at sarif leftover-join.v8 and drew no objection from either independent reviewer in a round that produced six findings.
